Harel Insurance (הראל חברה לביטוח) is its insurer subsidiary; the investment-contract figures are printed in the parent report in the note on operating segments (life insurance and long-term savings) and in the balance sheet / insurance notes. The insurer's stand-alone report was not used. Amounts in NIS million as printed.
Page = 1-based PDF page of the downloaded MAYA PDF. A "-" printed in a cell is stored as 0; parentheses are negative.

investment_contract_deposits = "תקבולים בגין חוזי השקעה" (receipts credited directly to investment-contract reserves; not included in premiums). investment_contract_aum = liabilities for yield-dependent investment contracts (the figure the deck calls assets under management); the not-yield-dependent liabilities are small and kept as a separate metric.

IFRS 17 / IFRS 9 report (first time adoption; comparatives for 2024 restated, marked * in the report). Q1 = three months, window q. The corrected re-filing of this report (MAYA id 1670840, "תיקון דטעות קולמוס") differs from this file only on PDF page 38 (income statement), not on the pages used here.

Segment note columns: total, life insurance, investment contracts (חוזי השקעה), pension, provident; the investment-contracts column is used. FY2024 expenses and profit here (116 / 40) differ from the FY2025 annual report comparative (129 / 27): both are kept as printed in their own report.
